response: According to the current expense reimbursement policy (expenses‑v2.md), Meridian Logistics reimburses employee travel meals at a flat per diem of **$65 USD per day**, regardless of destination【expenses‑v2.md】. This rate supersedes the earlier $45 USD per day rate in the historical policy (expenses‑v1.md)【expenses‑v1.md】. Therefore, for a 3‑day domestic business trip, the applicable per diem rate is $65 USD per day (totaling $195 USD for the trip).
